description: As the government celebrates 12 years of the Make in India initiative, Union Minister of Electronics and Information Technology, Ashwini Vaishnaw, has highlighted the growing depth of India's smartphone manufacturing ecosystem. The minister said that India is moving from assembling handsets to producing components and materials used inside them. In a series of posts on X, Vaishnaw explained how the manufacturing ecosystem is moving further up the supply chain. His comments come as the government pushes the Rs. 62,500 crore Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme.
title: Marking 12 Years of Make in India, Gov't Targets the Brains Inside Our Smartphones

description: Amazon is currently offering Early Deals ahead of the Great Indian Festival 2026. The sale offers customers access to discounted prices on several smartphones ahead of the main festive sale. The Amazon Great Indian Festival will begin on October 8, while the early offers are already available on the platform. Customers can also avail of a 10 percent instant discount when using eligible SBI Credit or Debit Cards and EMI transactions.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Early Deals Are Now Live on OnePlus N6x, iQOO Z10 Lite 5G, and More

description: Magic Eden is facing questions over unusual Ethereum NFT transactions involving several thousand tokens that appeared to move for 0 ETH. NFT trader Cirrus first flagged the activity on September 25, while another pseudonymous account claimed it was a whitehat operation. Magic Eden had not publicly confirmed an exploit or the legitimacy of the recovery effort at the time of writing. The number of affected wallets and total NFT value remain unclear.
title: Magic Eden Investigates Possible Exploit After NFTs Move for 0 ETH

description: Vivo V80 price in India has reportedly been revealed ahead of its October 6 launch. A tipster claims the 8GB + 128GB variant will carry a box MRP of Rs. 1,19,999, while its actual launch price could be above Rs. 60,000. The leak also points to a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, LPDDR4X RAM, UFS 3.1 storage and IP68/IP69 ratings. Vivo has already confirmed a 144Hz display, ZEISS cameras, a 7,200mAh battery and 90W charging.
title: Vivo V80 Price in India Leaked Ahead of October 6 Launch: What You Need to Know

description: OpenAI is planning to release a new cybersecurity-focused AI model, called GPT-6 Cyber, according to a report citing people familiar with the matter. The AI model will reportedly first be released in preview in the coming weeks. However, the report does not specify the exact date. The new GPT-6 Cyber AI model will reportedly be accompanied by a new consumer “product”, which will let customers deploy it in a “more secure” manner. The model is reportedly capable of automatically patching cybersecurity vulnerabilities, stopping bad actors from exploiting vulnerabilities with the help of AI-powered tools. On top of this, the new cybersecurity-focused AI model will reportedly allow OpenAI to monitor how its models are being utilised.
title: OpenAI Plans to Launch a New Cybersecurity-Focused GPT-6 Series AI Model: Report

description: KelpDAO has filed a civil claim in British Columbia against LayerZero and co-founder Bryan Pellegrino over an April attack that resulted in the loss of 116,500 rsETH worth about $292 million (roughly Rs. 2,797 crore). KelpDAO alleges LayerZero failed to disclose risks linked to the bridge’s verification setup. Pellegrino has called the claims “meritless” and said he will defend himself and LayerZero.
title: KelpDAO Sues LayerZero Over $292 Million rsETH Exploit, Claims Bridge Risks Were Not Disclosed

description: Halo Studios has around 30 employees left, including studio head Pierre Hintze after Xbox announced a new round of layoffs and studio reorganisation this week. The developer multiple Halo projects in the concept and planning phase before being hit with layoffs. The next Halo game will now be made by Activision.
title: Halo Studios Reportedly Has Around 30 Employees Left After Layoffs as Activision Takes Charge of Franchise

description: Google Photos is expanding its editing and AI capabilities with several new features across Android and iOS. The updated Markup tool can blur sensitive information, while Moods brings AI-assisted visual styles to photos on Android. Google is also adding 15 Remix templates and expanding Wardrobe to users in India, the US and Brazil. Gemini Spark can use photos to help select and prepare family portraits, although the feature is currently limited to eligible Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US.
title: Google Photos Update Brings Redact Tool, Moods and AI Wardrobe

description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G will be launched in India on October 5, according to a tipster. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G will reportedly be powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Max chipset, while the Oppo F35 5G is said to feature the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 SoC. The Oppo F35 5G could sport a 6.57-inch Full-HD+ AMOLED display, delivering up to a 120Hz refresh rate. The Pro model is said to also offer Rainstorm Touch support. Both smartphones will reportedly be equipped with an 8,000mAh battery, while offering support for 80W wired fast charging. The Oppo F35 series might arrive with a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter with optical image stabilisation. While the Pro model might feature an 8-megapixel ultrawide rear camera, the standard model is said to offer a 2-megapixel secondary shooter.
title: Oppo F35 Series India Launch Date Tipped Online, Price and Specifications Leaked: What You Need to Know

description: Bitget has reported a security breach involving approximately $351.6 million (roughly Rs. 3,369 crore) in assets. The exchange said its investigation has found no evidence of private-key leaks and that customer balances remain accurate. Deposits and trading remain operational, while withdrawals have been suspended. Blockchain data from Lookonchain identified XRP and Ether among the largest portions of the affected assets.
title: Bitget Suffers $351.6 Million Security Breach, Exchange Says No Private Keys Were Leaked

description: Infinix GT NX Series peripherals have been launched as the company's latest gaming accessories. It includes the GT NX Controller and GT NX Station. The new accessories are designed to address common mobile gaming issues such as touchscreen controls, thermal throttling and unstable wireless connections. The Infinix GT NX Controller features a glass touchpad. The GT NX Station features a 9-in-1 port setup.
title: Infinix GT NX Controller With Pixel-Level FPS Touchpad, GT NX Station Cooling Dock Unveiled

description: Age of Empires developer World's Edge has lost nearly half of its staff as part of widespread Xbox layoffs. The studio's next project has also been cancelled, according to a former employee, who was also laid off this week. World's Edge has been reorganised to operate under Call of Duty maker Activision.
title: Age of Empires Studio World's Edge Reportedly Loses Nearly Half Its Staff Before Moving Under Activision

description: Oppo K14 Plus 5G will be launched in India with a price tag of under Rs. 45,000, the company has revealed. This confirms that the Oppo K14 Plus 5G will be significantly more expensive than the Oppo K14 5G, which currently retails at a starting price of Rs. 25,999 for the 6GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration, going up to Rs. 28,999 for the top-end 6GB + 256GB variant. The Oppo K14 Plus 5G is confirmed to be launched in India on September 29 at 12 pm IST. The phone will be offered in orange and white colour options.
title: Oppo K14 Plus 5G Price Range in India, Among Other Details Revealed Ahead of Launch

description: HMD Vibe 2 Pro will launch in India on September 29. It is confirmed to come with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC and a 6,000mAh battery. It will feature a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 64-megapixel Sony main camera. The HMD Vibe 2 Pro will ship with Android 16. It will also include Indus AI, which HMD says can support 22 Indian languages. It will be available for purchase through Flipkart.
title: HMD Vibe 2 Pro India Launch Date Set for September 29; Teased to Feature Dimensity 6300 SoC

description: Flipkart is gearing up for its biggest festive sale of the year. The Big Billion Days Sale 2026 is all set to begin next month, bringing discounts across smartphones and other electronics. The e-commerce platform has already started teasing several smartphone deals. The lineup includes recent launches as well as some popular flagship and mid-range smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Google, Motorola, Realme, Vivo, and others. While the exact deal prices for several models are yet to be revealed, Flipkart has confirmed bank offers and early access for eligible customers.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale: iPhone 17, Google Pixel 11, Samsung Galaxy S25 and More to Get Discounts

description: Google has rolled out new Chrome features that give students more ways to study and manage coursework. Gemini in Chrome can now work with podcasts, videos and lecture recordings, while Chrome can generate quizzes from material in open tabs. The browser also improves cross-device tab transfers by preserving scroll positions and unfinished forms. Existing tools such as Tab Groups, Split View and Immersive Reading provide additional ways to organise research, work across multiple pages and customise how study material appears.
title: Google Chrome Gets New AI Features for Students, Including Interactive Quizzes and More

description: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max are confirmed to launch in global markets soon. The launch date has not been revealed, but they can now be reserved in the UK with a GBP 49 deposit ahead of their official launch.  The brand has also started accepting early blind pre-orders for the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max in the UK. The listing reveals the RAM and storage options and colours.
title: Oppo Find X10, Find X10 Pro Max Global Launch Teased; Colourways, RAM and Storage Configurations Revealed

description: A social media post now claims that global models of the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max may have lower-capacity batteries than their Chinese counterparts. The information is reportedly buried in HyperOS code and has revealed a 14 percent and 17 percent drop in capacity for each model, respectively.
title: Global Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max Reported to Get Smaller Batteries Compared to China Models

description: Vivo S2 FE will be launched in India on October 6 at 12 pm IST, the company has confirmed. Apart from this, the microsite confirms that the handset will be available for purchase in the country via Flipkart. In terms of design, it is shown in a green finish, sporting a flat rear panel. The square-shaped rear camera module will be placed in the top-left corner of the panel, with two camera lenses and an LED flash. On top of this, the power button and volume controls of the Vivo S2 FE will be placed on its right side, while the left side will be left clean. The phone is confirmed to ship with an unspecified version of OriginOS, too.
title: Vivo S2 FE India Launch Date Announced; Firm Reveals Design, Availability Details and More

description: Google has launched Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS for developers and users across its AI products. The new models support custom voice generation, voice replication and detailed control over speech delivery. Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS focuses on creative voice generation and long-form audio, while Flash-Lite targets larger-scale applications such as dubbing and voice agents. Both models support more than 100 languages and are available through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, with wider product rollouts underway.
title: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS Models With Custom Voice Creation and Control

description: Bitcoin is trading around $84,000 after retreating from recent highs as rising US Treasury yields and stronger jobs data weigh on risk appetite. However, steady ETF inflows and whale accumulation continue to support demand. Traders are also watching the Trump-Xi summit and the latest options expiry for potential market catalysts.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $84,000 as Bond Yields Test Rally Momentum

description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) has introduced a new international roaming benefit for eligible prepaid, postpaid, and enterprise customers in India. With this move, subscribers can avail of free international roaming across more than 170 countries, eliminating the need to purchase separate roaming packs or local SIMs when travelling overseas. The benefit will be valid for up to three trips in a year, depending on the plan. Vi says it is offering varied international data allowances and outgoing calling minutes, with claimed annual savings of up to Rs. 9,000.
title: Vodafone Idea (Vi) Rolls Out Free International Roaming on Select Prepaid, Postpaid Plans in India

description: Rockstar has announced a limited-edition GTA 6 collector's set, featuring Vice-City themed merchandise. The collector's box is now available to pre-order for $399.99. It does not come with a copy of the game. Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch on November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. The collector's box launches the same day.
title: GTA 6 Is Getting a $400 Collector's Box With Vice City Merchandise, but It Does Not Come With the Game

description: Vivo is said to be preparing to increase the prices of several smartphones in India. According to a tipster, the Chinese tech company could raise prices by up to Rs. 5,000 across its X, S, and Y series smartphones. The reported price revision affects several models across different storage configurations, with the steepest increase expected on the Vivo X300 FE. The 8GB + 256GB and 12GB + 256GB variants of the smartphone are reportedly set to become Rs. 5,000 more expensive. The move could come ahead of or after the upcoming Flipkart Big Billion Days and Amazon Great Indian Festival sales.
title: Vivo X300 FE, S2 and Y Series Prices Could Rise Soon in India, Tipster Claims

description: iPhone 18 Pro series will soon receive a new software update, which will fix the rebooting and freezing issues, Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac in a statement. The issue was first reported last week when users complained that their iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models froze and began rebooting after a failed unlock attempt via the Face ID sensor. The report highlights that Apple is aware of the issue and is currently working on a new iOS 27 update, which will be rolled out to the flagship iPhone 18 Pro series next week.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Rebooting Bug to Be Fixed With an Upcoming Software Update: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy Buds On have surfaced in a new leak that reveals their clip-on construction and reported features. Images shared by a new report show the earbuds with a wider inner section housing the speaker and a second section positioned outside the ear. The earbuds are also expected to use open-ear air-conduction technology. Other reported features include head gesture controls, automatic volume adjustment based on ambient noise, access to Bixby and Gemini, and sleep detection that could pause playback.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds On Leak Shows Clip-On Design, Hint at Head Gesture Controls

description: Meta has showcased a new standalone device called Muse Charm at its Connect event. The device resembles a small keychain or Tamagotchi-like gadget. It offers users quick access to Meta's AI assistant. It is expected to be available later this year.  It is integrated with Meta Muse and can interact with users through voice and an animated avatar. The device features a fingerprint sensor and has a front-facing camera. It will be available later this year.
title: Meta Muse Charm AI Wearable Device Unveiled at Meta Connect 2026: Here's What You Need to Know

description: A social media post recently revealed the Vivo S2 FE’s complete hardware specifications and launch timeline. The source also mentioned a launch timeline that reportedly aligns with the Vivo V80’s launch in India. New details have emerged, revealing the phone’s box price and storage variants.
title: Vivo S2 FE Box Price and Storage Variant Leak Ahead of India Launch

description: Adobe on Thursday announced the expansion of access to its creative and productivity tools across AI assistant platforms. The company is bringing Photoshop, Lightroom, Express, and Firefly capabilities to Gemini, Google’s AI assistant. Further, the Adobe plugin in Claude will gain Acrobat tools, enabling users to work with PDFs alongside Adobe's creative apps. Adobe said both integrations are rolling out globally, with the Gemini tools available across all Gemini plans.
title: Adobe’s Creative Tools Now Available in Gemini, Claude Gets New Acrobat PDF Features

description: Redmi 17C 5G will be launched in India soon, the company announced on Friday. The handset will arrive as the latest addition to the Redmi 17 lineup, which already includes the Redmi 17 5G. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Xiaomi sub-brand has also provided us with a glimpse of the handset’s design. It appears to be identical to the global model that was released in August. Apart from this, the colour options of the Redmi 17C 5G have been revealed as well.
title: Redmi 17C 5G India Launch Date Announced; Design, Colour Options Revealed

description: Vivo Y600i has been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Friday. The smartphone is set to go on sale in the country on September 30 via the Vivo China online store. The Vivo Y600i is offered in three colour options, namely Baby’s Breath, Clear Blue, and Polar Night Black (translated from Chinese). It is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, which is built on a 4nm process. The phone is equipped with an 8,000mAh battery, offering support for 44W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo Y600i Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series was launched in China earlier this week, comprising the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max models. The company has now teased the India and global launch of its flagship smartphone lineup. Both models are equipped with secondary rear displays and the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chipsets. While Xiaomi has not revealed the India launch date or pricing yet, the teaser confirms that the Pro model is headed to the country.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro India Launch Teased Following China Debut; to Feature Secondary Rear Screen
